speed.notes: 30 ft., Burrow 15 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 30 ft.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.text: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, Difficult Terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +4, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. _Failure:_ 22 (5d8) Cold damage. _Success:_ Half damage.
